name: Tsogo Sun Limited
source: Audited consolidated annual financial statements 2026, Tsogo Sun Limited, year ended 31 March 2026 (Deloitte and Touche), consolidated statement of financial position and consolidated statement of cash flows
note: Printed in R millions, stored here in absolute rand. Current assets include R151m (2025: nil) of assets classified as held for sale and current liabilities include R4m (2025: nil) of liabilities classified as held for sale, which IFRS 5 requires the issuer to present on separate lines; including them keeps non-current plus current equal to the printed totals. Capital expenditure is the purchase of property, plant and equipment, intangible assets and additions to investment properties.
